title: Composition-pinned tensor comparison on a single complex
statement: Let schemes and module sheaves be as in [def-pc-scheme] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category], tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Fix the left-derived counit family $\epsilon_k:Q_h\circ Lk^*\to k^*\circ Q_h$ selected together with the composition structure in [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For every scheme morphism $k:X\to Y$ with additive tensor pullback, every $\mathcal O_Y$-module $M$, and every integer $n$, define $d_k(M,n):Lk^*(M[-n])\to(k^*M)[-n]$ as $\epsilon_k$ at the homotopy single complex of $M$ in degree $n$, followed by $Q_h$ of the termwise single-complex tensor-pullback identification. Here $M[-n]$ denotes $M$ placed in cohomological degree $n$. This is the specified component of the composition-pinned counit, with no independently chosen comparison map and no flatness, nonemptiness, or quasi-coherence hypothesis.

def pinnedSingleDegreeTensorComparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (k : X ⟶ Y) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    (M : Y.Modules) (n : ℤ) :
    (derivedPullback k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj M) ⟶
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M)
